question: do reported earnings and cash reflect economic reality?

earnings_versus_cash.finding: Headline: operating cash flow over net income is {earnings_versus_cash.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income} and accruals over average assets are {earnings_versus_cash.accruals_over_average_assets}, so net income of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.net_income} is matched by operating cash flow of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.operating_cash_flow}. Against the company's own history this is a break, not a trend: the earlier fiscal years were losses, with the cash ratio at {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.1.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income}, {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.2.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income} and {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.3.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income}. Accruals over total assets are {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.accruals_over_total_assets}, the highest (least cash-backed) of the filled years, against {trend_table.years-back-1.ratios.accruals_over_total_assets} and {trend_table.years-back-2.ratios.accruals_over_total_assets}; the benign reading is that earlier years carried large non-cash charges such as the goodwill impairment. Underneath the near-one ratio, working capital absorbed a large part of earnings: receivables rose {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.balance_sheet_change}, or {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.share_of_net_income|pct} of net income, and inventory {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.balance_sheet_change}, or {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.share_of_net_income|pct}; trade payables supplied only {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.cash_flow_statement_change}. The gap was filled by customer cash under the new multi-year agreements (refundable security deposits and advances, which the company itself deducts in its adjusted free cash flow), by a build in current income tax payable while cash taxes paid were a small fraction of current tax expense, and by contract-liability growth. The fourth quarter shows it most: derived fourth-quarter operating cash flow is {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.this_quarter} against net income of {ratios.growth.net_income.this_quarter}, and the release places most of the year's agreement prepayments and deposits, most of the receivable build and nearly all of the refund-liability increase in that quarter. Net income also holds a non-cash fair-value gain on the Nanya stake, which pulls the other way. Articulation is clean where testable: receivables gap {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.articulation_gap}, inventory gap {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.articulation_gap}; payables cannot be tested because no payables balance is tagged in any period. Smoothness is {earnings_versus_cash.smoothness}, above one, so income moved more than cash; no smoothing pattern. Adjustments applied: current contract liabilities and the timing-driven payables increase come out of free cash flow; the refundable deposits and tax-payable build are not in the calculator and are named, not applied.
earnings_versus_cash.verdict: Earnings are covered by cash on the headline ratio, but the cover rests on non-recurring customer deposits and advances and on tax not yet paid, while receivables absorbed a large share of earnings; underlying cash quality is weaker than the ratio shows.

revenue_recognition.finding: Receivables outran revenue on every year-end measure Python computed: days sales outstanding is {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding}, the highest of the filled years, against {trend_table.years-back-1.ratios.days_sales_outstanding} and {trend_table.years-back-2.ratios.days_sales_outstanding}; receivables over revenue is {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.receivables_over_revenue} against {trend_table.years-back-1.ratios.receivables_over_revenue}; on average balances the figure is {ratios.efficiency.days_sales_outstanding}. The MD&A says receivable days fell on shipment timing and strong collections, so the numbers contradict the prose. The benign reading is strong: the company probably measures on fourth-quarter revenue, which rose {ratios.growth.revenue.quarter_over_quarter|pct} on the third quarter; Python derived no fourth-quarter receivable days, and its latest quarterly figure, {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.days_sales_outstanding}, is low in the quarterly history; the year had an extra week, and rebates are netted against open receivables. Contract liabilities moved with revenue, not against it: current contract liabilities over revenue rose to {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.contract_liabilities_over_revenue} from {trend_table.years-back-1.ratios.contract_liabilities_over_revenue}, driven by customer advances, i.e. cash ahead of revenue. The new multi-year agreements are the main new judgment area: committed volumes, fixed and variable pricing, financial guarantees, refundable deposits and third-party collateral, with a remaining performance obligation that depends on transaction-price estimates and a cumulative catch-up revenue adjustment from re-estimating price (see estimates). Price protection and incentive programmes fell as a share of gross revenue, which raises net revenue, with no cause stated. The fourth quarter carried {ratios.growth.revenue.this_quarter} of the year's {terms.trailing_four_quarters.revenue}, attributed mainly to pricing. Bill-and-hold and extended payment terms: nothing found; neither report mentions them and the notes reader lists payment terms as unchanged. No credit-loss allowance is tagged in any period, so no allowance ratio exists.
revenue_recognition.verdict: Revenue now depends more on estimates, and receivables grew faster than revenue on the computed measures, contradicting the stated fall in receivable days; cash received ahead of revenue partly offsets the concern.

estimates_and_reserves.finding: Reserves thinned against their bases. Inventory reserve over inventory is {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.inventory_reserve_ratio} against {trend_table.years-back-1.ratios.inventory_reserve_ratio}: the reserve held at {terms.balances_now.inventory_reserve} against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.inventory_reserve} while inventory grew and write-downs rose to {terms.trailing_four_quarters.inventory_write_down}; the MD&A calls reserve adjustments immaterial, which the flat balance matches. Warranty accrual over revenue is {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.warranty_reserve_ratio}, the lowest of the filled years against {trend_table.years-back-1.ratios.warranty_reserve_ratio}, {trend_table.years-back-2.ratios.warranty_reserve_ratio} and {trend_table.years-back-3.ratios.warranty_reserve_ratio}, and the rollforward shows a negative change in estimate on pre-existing warranties, a release into income that no prose explains; the amounts are small. The largest estimate item is the cumulative catch-up adjustment to revenue from changes in the estimate of transaction price, larger for the full year than at nine months per the numbers reader; it raised revenue under variable-pricing agreements, can reverse, and is not in the calculator, so no amount is applied. The effective tax rate is {tax_rate.effective_rate}, held down by Malaysian tax holidays expiring between 2028 and 2031 and a foreign-derived deduction; the company expects the minimum tax and foreign rate changes to raise it from fiscal 2027. Tax reserves moved conservatively: unrecognized tax benefits and the valuation allowance both rose, so there is no valuation-allowance release. No goodwill impairment this year after the prior year's charge; with operating income of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.operating_income}, headroom is not a concern, and no discount-rate or growth assumption is in the input. The Nanya stake is carried at quoted price despite a statutory lock-up and was bought at a discount to the trailing average, so part of the gain through income may reflect the purchase discount; the gain is not in the calculator.
estimates_and_reserves.verdict: Mixed: inventory and warranty cover thinned, and a warranty release and a large catch-up revenue re-estimate raised income, while tax reserves moved conservatively; the tax rate is temporarily low.

cost_deferral.finding: No development cost is capitalized: the capitalized-development concept is untagged in every period and research and development of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.research_and_development_expense} is expensed. The soft-asset share fell to {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.soft_asset_share}, the lowest of the filled years against {trend_table.years-back-1.ratios.soft_asset_share} and {trend_table.years-back-2.ratios.soft_asset_share}, because cash grew; not a deferral signal. Smaller deferrals exist: qualification units, once given away and expensed in selling expense, are now held in inventory until sold; payments to Kioxia under the collaboration agreement are amortized into inventory and reach cost of revenue only on sale; Flash Ventures building-depreciation prepayments sit in assets and are credited against future wafer purchases. The non-GAAP gap is not computed because no non-GAAP concept is tagged; this year the release prints non-GAAP net income below GAAP because it removes the Nanya gain, so the gap does not flatter the period. But the exclusions include legal settlements of 'previously existing' matters, a debt-extinguishment loss, a divestiture loss and the equity-securities line, which by the policy note also holds equity-method results; if those recur, later non-GAAP results would be flattered. Capital expenditure of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.capital_expenditure} sits close to depreciation and amortization of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.depreciation_and_amortization}, and the company plans more capital spending in fiscal 2027.
cost_deferral.verdict: Low: no capitalized development cost and no rise in soft assets; some supply and sample costs now pass through inventory or prepaid assets, and some non-GAAP exclusion categories could recur.

cash_flow_engineering_and_off_balance_sh.finding: Receivables factoring: nothing found; the calculator has no proceeds-from-sale-of-receivables row and the notes reader lists the factoring paragraphs as history, with no factoring at the year-end date. Supplier finance: nothing found; no obligation is tagged and no notes item mentions a programme. The material items are elsewhere. Operating cash flow includes customer cash under the new multi-year agreements: refundable security deposits held as refund liabilities, repayable at contract end and behaving like customer financing, and advances held as contract liabilities (current balance {terms.balances_now.contract_liabilities} against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.contract_liabilities}); the company's own adjusted free cash flow deducts these. Cash taxes paid were far below current tax expense and current income tax payable rose, so part of this year's operating cash is a deferred tax outflow. Flash Ventures distributions moved from investing cash flow in fiscal 2025 to operating cash flow in fiscal 2026, a classification shift that lifts operating cash flow by an amount not in the calculator. Loans to Flash Forward run through investing cash flow, so capital expenditure of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.capital_expenditure} alone understates spending on capacity. Off the balance sheet, purchase obligations rose to {terms.balances_now.unconditional_purchase_obligations} from {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.unconditional_purchase_obligations}; related-party guarantees and variable-interest exposure are reported by the numbers reader but do not reach the calculator, whose guarantee field is missing; customer collateral held by third parties is not recognized. Operating leases are small at {terms.balances_now.operating_lease_liability}. Share-based compensation of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_based_compensation} is a real cost and is already subtracted in quality-adjusted free cash flow. Adjustments applied: current contract liabilities and the timing-driven payables increase reduce free cash flow once; refundable deposits, the tax-payable build, reclassified distributions and the Flash Forward loans are not in the calculator and are named, not applied.
cash_flow_engineering_and_off_balance_sh.verdict: Operating cash flow is lifted by refundable customer deposits, customer advances, deferred tax payments and a classification shift; no factoring or supplier finance is found; off-balance-sheet commitments grew.

controls_audit_and_filing_signals.finding: KPMG gives clean opinions on the statements and on internal control; management reports internal control effective with no fourth-quarter change; no material weakness; no auditor change. The single critical audit matter is the sufficiency of audit evidence over revenue, driven by highly automated processing; whether it is new cannot be told without the prior 10-K. The 10-K re-presents prior-year-end accrued liabilities and other non-current liabilities: the second-quarter 10-Q, third-quarter 10-Q and 10-K print different values for one date. The notes explain a reclassification of contract liabilities, refund liabilities and non-current income tax payable into separate lines, and the new tags first appear in the same filings where the old balances fall, so this reads as reclassification, though no Python reconciliation exists. A year-to-date series of increases to unrecognized tax benefits for prior-period positions does not build (lower at nine months than at six), so an interim figure was revised without a trace; the release refers to re-measuring these benefits. The annual notes carry several drafting errors absent from the MD&A. Tagging is inconsistent: one refund balance under two concepts; the third receivable-concentration customer tagged on the revenue benchmark; Malaysian pre-tax income tagged at the holiday-benefit amount; an unbilled-receivable concept larger than total assets; accounts payable untagged in every period. An officer-change 8-K was filed in January 2026 but its text is not in the input, so a chief financial officer, chief accounting officer or controller departure can be neither found nor ruled out. No late filing or amendment is visible; the subsidiary-list exhibit and comment letters are not in the input. Related-party balances grew: Flash Forward notes receivable rose; WDC ceased to be a related party at year end.
controls_audit_and_filing_signals.verdict: Clean audit and control opinions with no material weakness; filing-quality signals are present: re-presented prior balances explained as reclassification, a revised interim tax-reserve series, drafting errors and several tagging inconsistencies.

cross_document_reconciliation.finding: The 8-K release matches the 10-K on every line the numbers reader checked: Python's derived fourth-quarter revenue {ratios.growth.revenue.this_quarter} equals the release's quarter; the release balance sheet's refund liabilities, contract liabilities, receivables and re-presented accrued expenses match the 10-K facts; its receivable cash-flow change equals the calculator's {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.cash_flow_statement_change}; the prior-year goodwill impairment matches up to rounding. This period is a 10-K, so the release is compared with the 10-K, not a 10-Q. Of the notes reader's directional items, most are confirmed and the forward-looking ones are unresolved; one is contradicted: the MD&A statement that receivable days fell on strong collections. Other disagreements: legal settlements are stated differently in the notes, the MD&A and the release and are not reconciled; the policy note and the investee notes place equity-method results on different lines, which matters because the non-GAAP exclusion follows the policy note; the MD&A attributes working-capital use to volume while the same MD&A and the release attribute growth mainly to price; the release and the subsequent-events note count new agreements over different windows.
cross_document_reconciliation.verdict: The release and the annual filing agree; one management explanation is contradicted by the numbers and several cross-document statements are unreconciled.

industry_lens.finding: Inventory obsolescence: inventory days on year-end balances are {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory}, the highest of the filled years, against {trend_table.years-back-1.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory}, and the third quarter at {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory} was the highest of the filled quarters; the company attributes this to builds for demand, which a price-led upcycle supports, but reserve cover thinned at the same time, so losses would surface here if prices turn. Purchase commitments in excess of need: none stated, but obligations rose to {terms.balances_now.unconditional_purchase_obligations} from {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.unconditional_purchase_obligations}; the Nanya arrangement commits annual DRAM volumes; the Flash Ventures and Kioxia arrangements run to 2034; an SDSS supply agreement has a minimum annual commitment that stated purchases fell short of. Customer concentration: top-ten customers' revenue share is {concentration.facts.26|pct} against {concentration.facts.11|pct} and {concentration.facts.0|pct} earlier, after {concentration.facts.20|pct} in the third quarter; the largest customer's share of receivables rose to {concentration.facts.27|pct} from {concentration.facts.12|pct}, and a second holds {concentration.facts.28|pct}. Channel stuffing: no direct sign; growth is price-led, customers prepay and post deposits, and Consumer lost volume; but revenue attributed to Hong Kong, China and the rest of Asia rose steeply, the fourth quarter carried a large share of the year with receivables building in it, and no sell-through data are in the input. Circular or vendor-financed deals: Unis Venture is an equity-method investee that also buys from the company, with a receivable share of {concentration.facts.25|pct} at nine months and {concentration.facts.31|pct} at year end, small; Nanya and Flash Ventures are suppliers, not customers. Under the new agreements cash flows the other way: customers finance the company.
industry_lens.verdict: Price-led upcycle with rising inventory, commitments and concentration: no direct sign of channel loading or customer-side vendor financing, but the exposures that would become losses in a downturn grew.

anomalies.name: New multi-year agreements bring variable-pricing, deposit and collateral judgments
anomalies.name_ko: 신규 다년 계약에 따른 변동가격·보증금·담보 판단
anomalies.what: Sales increasingly run under agreements with committed volumes, fixed and variable pricing, financial guarantees, refundable deposits and third-party collateral. The remaining performance obligation sits entirely in them and depends on transaction-price estimates; refund liabilities mix deposits with rebates. A new judgment area with no history to compare.

anomalies.name: Price protection and incentives fell as a share of gross revenue
anomalies.what: The MD&A reports price protection and incentive programmes at a lower share of gross revenue than in earlier years. These variable-consideration estimates reduce revenue, so a lower share raises net revenue. No cause is stated; a pricing upcycle is the benign reading. No figure is in the calculator.

anomalies.name: Fourth quarter carries a large share of the year
anomalies.what: Derived fourth-quarter revenue is {ratios.growth.revenue.this_quarter} of the year's {terms.trailing_four_quarters.revenue}, up {ratios.growth.revenue.quarter_over_quarter|pct} sequentially, mainly on price. The same quarter holds most of the receivable build and NBM inflow, and the catch-up revenue adjustment is larger for the year than at nine months. Benign reading: a steep price upcycle.

anomalies.name: Rebates netted against open receivables
anomalies.what: Rebates are netted against open receivables when offset criteria are met, lowering reported receivables and receivable days. No netting amount and no allowance is tagged, so the gross position cannot be seen; newness cannot be confirmed.

anomalies.name: Contract liabilities jump with customer advances
anomalies.what: Current contract liabilities over revenue rose to {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.contract_liabilities_over_revenue} from {trend_table.years-back-1.ratios.contract_liabilities_over_revenue}; the balance is {terms.balances_now.contract_liabilities} against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.contract_liabilities}, with a non-current part outside the formula, and the tag history starts only in the third-quarter 10-Q. Cash ahead of revenue is the benign direction, but future revenue will arrive without matching cash.

anomalies.name: Extra week in the fiscal year
anomalies.what: The fiscal year had an extra week in its first quarter, so annual revenue and day-count ratios span a longer period than the prior year, and next year's first quarter compares against a longer quarter. Small against revenue growth of {ratios.growth.revenue.trailing_four_quarters|pct}.

anomalies.name: Inventory reserve cover thinning as inventory grows
anomalies.name_ko: 재고 증가 속 재고충당금 비율 하락
anomalies.what: Inventory reserve over inventory is {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.inventory_reserve_ratio} against {trend_table.years-back-1.ratios.inventory_reserve_ratio}; the reserve held at {terms.balances_now.inventory_reserve} against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.inventory_reserve} while inventory grew and write-downs rose to {terms.trailing_four_quarters.inventory_write_down}. The MD&A's 'immaterial' adjustments match the flat balance; the thinner cover matters if prices fall.

anomalies.name: Warranty release and lowest warranty ratio
anomalies.what: Warranty accrual over revenue is {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.warranty_reserve_ratio}, the lowest of the filled years against {trend_table.years-back-1.ratios.warranty_reserve_ratio}, {trend_table.years-back-2.ratios.warranty_reserve_ratio} and {trend_table.years-back-3.ratios.warranty_reserve_ratio}. The rollforward shows a negative change in estimate on pre-existing warranties after a positive one the year before, and the year-end accrual {terms.balances_now.warranty_accrual} sits below the third-quarter balance. No prose explains it; small, but income-raising.

anomalies.name: Large catch-up revenue from re-estimating transaction price
anomalies.name_ko: 거래가격 재추정에 따른 대규모 누적 매출 조정
anomalies.what: The 10-K tags a cumulative catch-up adjustment to revenue from changes in the estimate of transaction price, and the third-quarter 10-Q tagged a smaller nine-month figure, so much of it arose in the fourth quarter. It raises income under variable pricing in an upcycle and can reverse. No prose explains it and it is not in the calculator, so no adjustment is applied.

anomalies.name: No credit-loss allowance visible as receivables surge
anomalies.what: Receivables rose to {terms.balances_now.receivables} from {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.receivables}, with more single-customer concentration, but no allowance is tagged in any period, so whether it kept pace cannot be tested.

anomalies.name: Tax rate held down by holidays the company expects to fade
anomalies.name_ko: 만료 예정 조세감면에 기댄 낮은 유효세율
anomalies.what: The effective tax rate is {tax_rate.effective_rate}, lowered by Malaysian tax holidays expiring between 2028 and 2031, a foreign-derived deduction and credits. The company expects the minimum tax and foreign rate changes to raise the rate and lower operating cash flow from fiscal 2027.

anomalies.name: Tax reserves and valuation allowance rose
anomalies.what: Unrecognized tax benefits and the valuation allowance both rose year over year, with large current-period increases: the conservative direction, with no valuation-allowance release. The release's non-GAAP tax adjustments include re-measuring these benefits.

anomalies.name: Nanya stake at quoted price despite lock-up and discounted purchase
anomalies.name_ko: 보호예수에도 시가로 평가된 할인 매입 Nanya 지분
anomalies.what: The Nanya shares are carried at quoted price despite a statutory lock-up and were bought at a discount to the trailing average, so the gain through income may include the purchase discount. A deferred tax liability on unrealized gains appears for the first time.

anomalies.name: Qualification-unit costs moved from expense to inventory
anomalies.name_ko: 시험용 제품 원가를 비용에서 재고로 이연
anomalies.what: Qualification units, once free samples expensed in selling expense, are now sold and their cost held in inventory until sale. A cost once expensed when incurred is now deferred. Inventory rose {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.balance_sheet_change}; the qualification-unit part is not separable and SG&A is not in the calculator.

anomalies.name: Supplier payments and prepayments routed through assets
anomalies.what: Payments to Kioxia over 2026 through 2029 are amortized into inventory and reach cost of revenue only on sale; Flash Ventures building-depreciation prepayments are carried as assets and credited against future wafer purchases. Cost of revenue of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.cost_of_revenue} lags the cash paid.

anomalies.name: Non-GAAP exclusions include categories that could recur
anomalies.name_ko: 비GAAP 조정에 반복 가능 항목 포함
anomalies.what: The release excludes settlements of 'previously existing' legal matters, a debt-extinguishment loss, a divestiture loss and the equity-securities line, which by the policy note also holds equity-method results. The gap is not computed; this year non-GAAP sits below GAAP because the Nanya gain is removed, but recurring settlements or equity-method losses would flatter later non-GAAP results.

anomalies.name: Soft-asset share at its low
anomalies.what: Soft-asset share is {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.soft_asset_share} against {trend_table.years-back-1.ratios.soft_asset_share} and {trend_table.years-back-2.ratios.soft_asset_share}, because cash grew to {terms.balances_now.cash}. Benign; soft assets still include the Nanya stake, receivables, Flash Forward notes and supply prepayments.

anomalies.name: Refundable customer deposits and advances inside operating cash flow
anomalies.name_ko: 영업현금흐름에 포함된 환불 가능 고객 보증금·선수금
anomalies.what: Refund liabilities jumped, nearly all in the fourth quarter, on NBM security deposits refundable at contract end, which behave like customer financing yet sit in operating cash flow; advances add to it. The company's adjusted free cash flow deducts them. The refund amount is not in the calculator; current contract liabilities {terms.balances_now.contract_liabilities} are applied as an adjustment.

anomalies.name: Unpaid income tax lifts operating cash flow
anomalies.what: Cash taxes paid were far below current tax expense and current income tax payable rose sharply; the MD&A names tax-payment timing as a working-capital factor. Operating cash flow includes a tax outflow deferred to next year. Not in the calculator, so not applied.

anomalies.name: Flash Ventures distributions moved into operating cash flow
anomalies.what: Distributions were classified in investing cash flow in fiscal 2025 and in operating cash flow in fiscal 2026, netted in the equity-loss line in the release. The shift lifts operating cash flow against the prior presentation; the amount is in neither the numbers report nor the calculator.

anomalies.name: Purchase obligations rose
anomalies.what: Purchase obligations are {terms.balances_now.unconditional_purchase_obligations} against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.unconditional_purchase_obligations}, after a higher third-quarter print, with the Nanya DRAM arrangement and Kioxia payments added.

anomalies.name: Related-party guarantees and variable-interest exposure outside the calculator
anomalies.name_ko: 계산기에 반영되지 않은 특수관계자 보증·VIE 노출
anomalies.what: The numbers reader reports related-party guarantee exposure in dollars plus a yen amount and a variable-interest maximum loss; the Flash Ventures joint ventures now run to 2034. The calculator's guarantee field is missing because guarantees are tagged only on the related-party axis.

anomalies.name: Customer collateral held off the balance sheet
anomalies.what: NBM customers post collateral with third-party institutions that is not recognized unless a default occurs; it backs the agreements but sits outside the balance sheet.

anomalies.name: Lending to supplier joint ventures sits outside capital expenditure
anomalies.name_ko: 공급 합작사 대출이 설비투자 밖에 위치
anomalies.what: Notes receivable from Flash Forward, a related party, rose with new loans in the year, and payments to equity-method investees are tagged at large amounts. These fund capacity the company uses but run through investing lines, so capital expenditure of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.capital_expenditure} and simple free cash flow of {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_simple} omit them.

anomalies.name: Payables timing supplied cash
anomalies.what: Trade payables supplied {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.cash_flow_statement_change}; the MD&A attributes higher payable days to routine timing and says vendor payment timing is sometimes changed. No payables balance is tagged, so days payable cannot be computed. The timing amount is removed from free cash flow.

anomalies.name: Share-based compensation rising
anomalies.what: Share-based compensation is {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_based_compensation} against {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.1.share_based_compensation} and {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.2.share_based_compensation}; a real cost although no cash leaves, already subtracted in quality-adjusted free cash flow.

anomalies.name: Prior-year-end balances printed differently across filings
anomalies.name_ko: 전기 말 잔액이 공시마다 다르게 표시
anomalies.what: The second-quarter 10-Q, third-quarter 10-Q and 10-K print different prior-year-end accrued liabilities, and other non-current liabilities change between filings. The notes explain a reclassification into separate contract-liability, refund-liability and non-current tax-payable lines, which first appear in the same filings; reads as reclassification, with no Python reconciliation.

anomalies.name: Interim tax-reserve series revised without trace
anomalies.name_ko: 중간기 세무충당금 수치의 흔적 없는 수정
anomalies.what: Year-to-date increases to unrecognized tax benefits for prior-period positions print lower at nine months than at six, then higher for the full year, so an interim figure was revised or reclassified without a visible trace. The release mentions re-measuring these benefits.

anomalies.name: Drafting errors in the annual notes
anomalies.what: A share count written as dollars, a truncated legal sentence, an exchange rate without currency, a garbled vesting sentence, an inverted fee description and a changed recognition horizon all appear in the notes but not in the MD&A. A review-quality signal, not a misstated number.

anomalies.name: Critical audit matter on revenue evidence
anomalies.what: The only critical audit matter is the sufficiency of evidence over revenue of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.revenue}, given highly automated processing. Newness cannot be judged without the prior 10-K; it sits beside the areas where revenue depends most on estimates.

anomalies.name: Third receivable-concentration customer tagged on the revenue benchmark
anomalies.name_ko: 세 번째 매출채권 집중 고객이 매출 기준으로 태그됨
anomalies.what: The note gives three customers' shares of receivables. The tags put the first and second on the receivables benchmark ({concentration.facts.27|pct}, {concentration.facts.28|pct}) but the third ({concentration.facts.29|pct}) on the revenue benchmark. Either the axis is wrong or one customer sits exactly at the revenue disclosure threshold.

anomalies.name: One balance under two concepts and two precisions
anomalies.what: The refund balance is tagged under two concepts in one filing, and the goodwill impairment and receivables print at two precisions; tagging inconsistencies, not amount differences.

anomalies.name: Malaysian pre-tax income tagged at the holiday-benefit amount
anomalies.what: Malaysian pre-tax income is tagged at the same amount as the Malaysian tax-holiday reconciling item; a benefit equal to the income it shelters is implausible, so one tag likely carries the wrong concept.

anomalies.name: Unbilled-receivable concept larger than total assets
anomalies.what: UnbilledContractsReceivable is tagged near the remaining performance obligation and above total assets of {terms.balances_now.assets}, so it is not a balance-sheet receivable; the notes describe it as the unbilled part of the obligation.

anomalies.name: Accounts payable untagged in every period
anomalies.what: No payables balance is tagged though the cash-flow change is; payable days, the cash conversion cycle, payables articulation and free cash flow to the firm cannot be computed.

anomalies.name: Officer-change 8-K without text
anomalies.what: An 8-K reporting an officer change was filed in January 2026, but only its item code is in the input, so a finance-officer departure can be neither found nor ruled out; the 10-K reports no fourth-quarter control change.

anomalies.name: Legal settlements stated differently across documents
anomalies.what: The note's settlement amount matches the tag; the release's 'Other, net' exclusion is larger and includes settlements; the MD&A attributes a still larger rise in other expenses mainly to settlements. Not reconciled, and the note sentence is truncated.

anomalies.name: Equity-method results placed on different lines
anomalies.what: The policy note books equity-method results in gain (loss) on equity securities, net; the SDSS and Unis notes say other income (expense), net; the release excludes the equity-securities line from non-GAAP, which would drop equity-method results if the policy note is right.

anomalies.name: Working-capital use attributed to volume while growth is price-led
anomalies.name_ko: 가격 주도 성장인데 운전자본 사용을 물량 탓으로 설명
anomalies.what: The MD&A attributes working-capital use to higher volume, while the same MD&A reports a mid-teens rise in exabytes and the release attributes most sequential growth to price. Receivables grew {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.balance_sheet_change} with revenue up {ratios.growth.revenue.trailing_four_quarters|pct}, so price drove most of the build.

anomalies.name: New-agreement counts use different windows
anomalies.name_ko: 신규 계약 건수의 집계 기간 상이
anomalies.what: The release counts agreements signed since the April call; the subsequent-events note counts those after the balance-sheet date with a transaction price. The windows differ, so the counts cannot be matched.

anomalies.name: Inventory days at a high with thinner reserve cover
anomalies.what: Inventory days are {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory} against {trend_table.years-back-1.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory} and {trend_table.years-back-2.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory}, with the third quarter at {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory}, the highest filled quarter. Builds for demand fit a price upcycle, but reserve cover thinned; losses would surface here if prices turn.

anomalies.name: Fixed supply commitments expanding into the upcycle
anomalies.what: Purchase obligations rose to {terms.balances_now.unconditional_purchase_obligations} from {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.unconditional_purchase_obligations}; Nanya commits annual DRAM volumes; Flash Ventures and Kioxia run to 2034; SDSS has a minimum annual commitment purchases fell short of; capital spending is set to rise. None is stated to exceed need; in a downturn they become loss exposures.

anomalies.name: Customer concentration rising
anomalies.what: Top-ten revenue share is {concentration.facts.26|pct} against {concentration.facts.11|pct} and {concentration.facts.0|pct} earlier, after {concentration.facts.20|pct} in the third quarter; the largest customer's receivable share rose to {concentration.facts.27|pct} from {concentration.facts.12|pct}, a second holds {concentration.facts.28|pct}.

anomalies.name: Revenue attributed to Hong Kong and Asia surged
anomalies.what: Revenue attributed to Hong Kong, China and the rest of Asia all rose steeply; Hong Kong is typically a distribution point. No sell-through data are in the input, so channel loading cannot be ruled in or out; price-led growth, customer prepayments and the Consumer volume decline argue against it.

anomalies.name: Equity-method investee that is also a customer
anomalies.what: Unis Venture, an equity-method investee, buys from the company: revenue share {concentration.facts.30|pct} for the year after {concentration.facts.23|pct} in the third quarter; receivable share {concentration.facts.25|pct} at nine months and {concentration.facts.31|pct} at year end. Small, but the pattern to watch for vendor-financed sales.

anomalies.name: Large related-party share of inventory
anomalies.what: Inventory tagged with the related-party member is a large part of total inventory of {terms.balances_now.inventory}, consistent with wafers from the Flash Ventures joint ventures, tying inventory cost to their fixed costs and utilization.

adjustments.name: Customer advances under new multi-year agreements (current contract liabilities)
adjustments.quote: The increase in contract liabilities during the period was driven by customer advances associated with NBMs entered into during the period.

adjustments.name: Trade payables increase attributed to timing
adjustments.quote: DPO increased 14 days over the prior year, primarily due to routine variations in the timing of purchases and payments

summary_ko.earnings_versus_cash: 영업현금흐름을 순이익으로 나눈 비율은 {earnings_versus_cash.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income}로 이익이 현금으로 뒷받침되는 것처럼 보이지만, 매출채권 증가가 순이익의 {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.share_of_net_income|pct}를 흡수했습니다. 그 공백은 신규 다년 계약 고객의 환불 가능 보증금·선수금과 아직 내지 않은 법인세로 메워졌으므로, 반복 가능한 현금창출력은 표면 수치보다 약합니다.
summary_ko.revenue_recognition: 연말 기준 매출채권회전일수는 {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding}일로 보유 연도 중 가장 높아, 회수가 좋아져 일수가 줄었다는 경영진 설명과 반대입니다. 변동가격이 들어간 신규 다년 계약이 거래가격 추정에 의존하는 큰 잔액을 만들었고, 마지막 분기 매출 {ratios.growth.revenue.this_quarter}이 연간 매출 {terms.trailing_four_quarters.revenue}의 큰 몫을 차지합니다.
summary_ko.estimates_and_reserves: 재고충당금 비율은 {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.inventory_reserve_ratio}로 전년 {trend_table.years-back-1.ratios.inventory_reserve_ratio}보다 낮아졌고 보증충당금 비율 {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.warranty_reserve_ratio}도 최저이며, 보증 추정치 환입과 거래가격 재추정에 따른 누적 매출 조정이 이익을 높였습니다. 유효세율 {tax_rate.effective_rate|pct}는 기한이 있는 말레이시아 조세감면 덕분에 낮지만, 세무충당금은 보수적으로 늘었습니다.
summary_ko.cost_deferral: 개발비 자본화는 없고 연구개발비 {terms.trailing_four_quarters.research_and_development_expense}는 모두 비용 처리되었습니다. 다만 시험용 제품 원가와 Kioxia 지급액이 재고·선급자산을 거쳐 나중에 비용이 되며, 비GAAP 조정은 소송합의·지분법 손익처럼 반복될 수 있는 항목을 제외합니다.
summary_ko.cash_flow_engineering_and_off_balance_sh: 매출채권 팩토링과 공급망금융은 발견되지 않았지만, 영업현금흐름에는 환불 가능한 고객 보증금, 선수금(유동 계약부채 {terms.balances_now.contract_liabilities}), 미납 법인세, 영업활동으로 재분류된 Flash Ventures 분배금이 들어 있습니다. 구매약정은 {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.unconditional_purchase_obligations}에서 {terms.balances_now.unconditional_purchase_obligations}로 늘었습니다.
summary_ko.controls_audit_and_filing_signals: 감사인 KPMG는 재무제표와 내부통제 모두 적정의견을 냈고 중요한 취약점은 없습니다. 다만 전기 말 잔액의 재표시(재분류로 설명됨), 중간기 세무충당금 수치의 흔적 없는 수정, 주석 작성 오류와 XBRL 태그 불일치가 보입니다.
summary_ko.cross_document_reconciliation: 8-K 실적 발표는 확인한 모든 항목에서 10-K와 일치하며 마지막 분기 매출 {ratios.growth.revenue.this_quarter}도 같습니다. 그러나 매출채권 회수일수가 줄었다는 경영진 설명은 계산된 수치와 반대이고, 소송합의 금액은 주석·MD&A·실적 발표에서 서로 다르게 제시됩니다.
summary_ko.industry_lens: 재고일수는 {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory}일로 가장 높은데 재고충당금은 얇아져, 메모리 가격이 꺾이면 진부화 손실이 나타날 수 있습니다. 상위 열 개 고객의 매출 비중은 {concentration.facts.26|pct}로 높아졌고 최대 고객의 매출채권 비중도 {concentration.facts.27|pct}로 커졌으며, 구매약정도 크게 늘었습니다.

limits: This analysis finds where the numbers and the explanations disagree, and where the company differs from its own past. It does not judge intent, and it cannot see evidence outside the filings, such as invoices or contracts.
